name: maybloom-stack
description: Skills for building on the maybloom stack: monorepos whose core is a Protocol Buffers + Connect-RPC contract with generated, typed edges on both sides of the wire. Validated paths include TypeScript (Fastify + Drizzle + PGlite) and Go (connect-go + sqlc + pgx) backends and an Expo Router interface; a shared core reference supports any other Connect-RPC language the user prefers. Also ships the delegation model the stack is built with: a skill for the tiers, the rules and the brief, and the builder and mechanic subagents.
